absenceRule: No direct collision found means no functional equivalent was found in the frozen verified corpus. It is not proof of universal novelty.

candidates.title: CooperScene workload-robust transport conclusion as a partial-identification certificate

occupiedConcepts.boundary: Application-centered C-V2X measurement already establishes that packet size, priority, timing alignment, concurrency, and application mix can change communication outcomes.

occupiedConcepts.work: Weak Supervision Performance Evaluation via Partial Identification
occupiedConcepts.boundary: Partial identification and sharp performance bounds under missing ground truth are established statistical ideas and cannot be claimed as new.
Independent C-V2X measurement and interoperability evidence already exists outside CooperScene.

remainingNovelty: Freeze the exact CooperScene release and expose the mapping from its Iperf-derived throughput process to candidate perception-message workloads as an explicit admissible transport-map set.
Compute sharp identified sets for deadline completion and any downstream stale-frame estimand instead of reporting one invented point estimate.
Return machine-checkable witness transport maps for both the optimistic and pessimistic endpoints.
State a falsifiable proposition: two admissible workload maps that are equally consistent with the release can induce materially different completion or downstream conclusions.
requiredBeforeReview: Freeze every official release object and parser hash.
Define an explicit function class mapping Iperf workload measurements to perception-message service, including packetization, concurrency, priority, and any calibration constraints.
Pre-register payload, deadline, queue, interpolation, and right-censoring support.
Prove or numerically verify bound sharpness and emit endpoint witnesses.
Keep packet loss, latency, jitter, retransmission, and MAC claims out unless separately observed.
forbiddenClaims: A physical-radio guarantee outside the admissible map assumptions.
A point estimate where the release identifies only an interval.

occupiedConcepts.boundary: Cooperative trajectory prediction itself is occupied.

remainingNovelty: Remove both public-path oracle channels, rather than replacing only ego future or only other-agent future.
Use a planner proposal distribution for ego futures and an independently generated infrastructure-only distribution for other-agent futures.
Define an explicit joint coupling rather than treating the two uncertainty sources independently.
Evaluate no-future, top-1, oracle, and full-marginalization controls under one leakage-audited data contract.
requiredBeforeReview: Repair the public execution and preprocessing contracts without relying on unpublished assets.
Prove that every deployment input is measurable at or before t0.
Specify the coupling, proposal support, calibration method, and inference-cost scaling.
Reproduce a loader-compatible non-oracle one-batch vertical slice before any performance claim.
Separate repository repair contribution from the scientific hypothesis.
forbiddenClaims: Faithful Co-MTP reproduction from the current public assets.
